P06 compares ordered post maps as well as full LLIR nodes; 400 single-call effect replays and eight additional 22-call sequences are checked independently. P08 has 96 equivalence-domain cases and four separately executed excluded-domain controls. The study does not execute upstream Scorch or constitute independent proof review.
